would_stop_scrolling: yes. 'DID SAUDI CHANGE ITS LAW?' over Ronaldo at the mic. It's Ronaldo and it sounds like someone got special treatment, so I stop. The picture itself is just a guy at a table, the question is doing the work.

moments.reaction: HOOKED. 'He'd come to South Africa' then 'he meant Saudi Arabia' with him scratching his ear looking caught out. Actually funny. Still only told about it though, I want to hear him say it.
Best stretch. 'The claim: Saudi law changed for him', 'the claim: a beach closed for a day'. Big yellow text I can read in the van. A whole beach? Ok tell me.
'What did Saudi Arabia really do for him and what did he do for Saudi Arabia.' Bit of a school essay question. I wanted the beach, not a topic.
Piers Morgan, betrayed by United, 37 with no club. I know this part but it moves fast and the pictures change, so I'm still here.
'SO WHO APPROACHED FIRST?' Bro nobody asked. You had me on the beach and the law and now it's who called who.
'THE ONLY FIRST-HAND ACCOUNT COMES FROM ITS PRESIDENT THEN, MUSALLI AL-MUAMMAR, THREE YEARS LATER.' Random guy in a headdress, sounds like a lecture. Thumb's moving.
SWIPE. 'IN JULY TWENTY TWENTY-TWO' and a timeline card with tiny text about Prince Khalid bin Fahd. And the bar says there's four more minutes of this.
If I'd stayed: 99 lashes for hugging a painter, bro WHAT. Best line in the whole thing and it's buried past 2 minutes, then it's dead in 5 seconds.
If I'd stayed: him in the dugout with his hand on his face, 'IN TEARS'. Felt that. First time it feels like a story about a person.
If I'd stayed: $643,836 a day in the red box, I'd screenshot that. But then it says 'our own maths' and 'by our arithmetic' like they're scared of their own number.
If I'd stayed: I waited 3 and a half minutes for the beach and it's 'couldn't trace it and can't disprove it'. So nothing. That's the payoff?
If I'd stayed: same 'NO EVIDENCE' card sitting there getting more and more fine print for like 10 seconds. Nobody in a van is reading that.

felt_cheap_or_ai: The black cards with gold tags. Same template over and over, tiny grey lines nobody can read ('Package about EUR 200m (AFP source: more than...)'), and the same ones come back. It's a PowerPoint. Most shots are a picture in a strip with its own blurry copy above and below; when a picture finally goes full screen, like the fireworks at 52 s, it looks ten times better, which shows how templated the rest is. Random dashcam shots of palm trees and a wall while it's talking about him and Georgina. Same skyline and tower again and again. A white web page screenshot of an article. Voice reads like a report: 'one tabloid, unconfirmed', 'by ESPN's count'. Captions are readable size-wise but numbers are written out and split up: 'A RECORD NINE HUNDRED' then 'FIFTY-SEVEN MILLION DOLLARS', 'ABOUT SIX POINT' then 'THREE FIVE MILLION'. Just put the number.
confusing: Who Al-Muammar is and why I should care. Which prince. Captions broken mid-thought, like 'IN LISBON OVERSEEN' then 'BY THE SPORTS MINISTER' when I never caught what happened in Lisbon. 'HOLD ON TO THAT ONE' at 85 s, hold on to what, the marrying joke? Dollars, euros and pounds all mixed together. Also it keeps saying 'we': we found nothing, we can't prove it. Who's we?
comment_you_would_post: bro said south africa and the whole video after that is 'we couldnt confirm' lmaooo
share_or_follow: No. Might send my boy a clip of the South Africa thing, the 99 lashes or the $643k a day, but not almost 5 minutes of this. No follow. A channel that keeps telling me it found nothing isn't one I'm coming back to.
one_change: Make it 60 seconds and kill who-approached-first. South Africa, then 'they say a law changed for him, a beach closed, 99 lashes', knock those down fast, then $643,836 A DAY as one giant number, end on him crying in the dugout. And tell me right away the beach and the law are unproven, don't make me wait 3 minutes to find out it's nothing.
